newsitem.title: USA: Cisco to install data network in China.
newsitem.headline: Cisco to install data network in China.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc said Tuesday it had been selected to supply and install a data traffic network in China linking the country's major banks and financial institutions.
Cisco will install the switches for the China National Financial Data Communications Backbone Network.
A backbone is the primary artery connecting traffic together on a high-end networking system. It may interconnect multiple locations, and smaller networks may be attached to it.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed but Cisco said it was a "multimillion-dollar contract."
Cisco said it will supply 200 Cisco StrataCom IGX multiservice switches, providing a national network capable of handling data traffic like Frame Relay and Asynchronous Transfer Mode.
The network will be capable of handling all forms of traffic, including voice, data, video, multimedia and Internet communications.
The network will span nearly 200 cities and will provide the data traffic infrastructure for China's central bank, Cisco said.
It also will be used by all of the country's commercial banks and by other financial intermediaries, and for interbank communication and information-processing.
The network will be jointly funded by the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications and the central bank.
